system.description:
When this spell is cast, one humanoid creature will imagine the caster to be their best friend, and treat them accordingly. It does not make them fanatically loyal and will not make them attack their other friends. Similarly, it does not create any romantic attachment and does not override consent. This spell works on any living humanoid, but not on undead or non-living creatures such as automatons and not on non-humanoid creatures. The target gets a spell save to avoid the effect.

If the caster behaves in an overtly hostile manner to the charmed target, such as attacking it or ordering others to attack it, then the charm is broken.

If the target fails its save, then they get another one periodically to throw off the charm effect. The frequency of the save is based on the target's intelligence:

0 Int = save every 120 days 1 Intelligence = save every 90 days 2 Intelligence = save every 60 days 3 Intelligence = save every 45 days 4–5 Intelligence = save every 30 days 6–8 Intelligence = save every 15 days 9–12 Intelligence = save every 7 days 13–15 Intelligence = save every 3 days 16–17 Intelligence = save every 24 hours 18 Intelligence = save every 8 hours 19 Intelligence = save every 3 hours 20 Intelligence = save every hour 21–29 Intelligence = save every 10 minutes 30+ Intelligence = save every round

If an immortal is charmed using this spell, they may make a save every 10 minutes even if they have less than 21 Int.
